candidate.entry_execution: next aligned 15m open after the frozen confirmation chain

development_data.fold_method: chronological contiguous walk-forward OOS folds with pooled reporting
development_data.embargo: one complete 15m execution bar between adjacent train/evaluation boundaries

portfolio.same_timestamp_priority: symbol alphabetical order for deterministic simulation

cost_model.funding: apply timestamped historical funding when available; otherwise report a separate conservative no-funding sensitivity and do not upgrade a failure

trade_accounting.intrabar_ambiguity: stop-first when stop and target are both touched inside the same source candle

decision_rule.pass: All development gates pass for the single frozen candidate.
decision_rule.fail: Any gate fails; do not tune this candidate from the observed PnL.
decision_rule.insufficient_activity: Fewer than 60 trades is a development failure, not permission to loosen recognition rules.
decision_rule.selection: Exactly one candidate exists; no best-of-many selection is permitted.

after_pass_only.holdout_period: must be selected from data never used for recognition, semantic review or development

execution_gate: Do not execute this study until the CI checks for the commit containing this preregistration and freeze document are green.
